newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper prices fell on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper prices fell on profit-taking.

text.p: Indian copper prices fell on profit-taking while nickel lost previous gains in trading on Monday, dealers said.

Ready copper fell by 100 rupees to 12,000 rupees on sustained pressure of arrivals and sluggish demand. It was down by 100 rupees on Saturday. Nickel fell by 300 to 39,300 rupees as fresh buying eased. It was up by 100 on Saturday.

"Profit-taking by stockists also dragged prices down," one trader said. Tin was steady at 36,000 rupees, zinc at 6,300 and lead at 4,900, respectively on little activity. Aluminium remained quiet at 7,450 rupees amid nominal trading.
